title: feat(status-pages): tables, snapshot contract and daily uptime counters

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge Held at 8 because a warning is open. 1 warning −1 · tests covered · risk medium · 1/1 new units observable Adds the status-page foundation: six new tables plus a migration, shared snapshot/overlay rules in `@maple/domain/status-page`, per-UTC-day uptime counters and `status_pages.revision` bumps wired into the uptime and alert paths. Safe to merge once the overlay's component-status handling is settled. - Checks roll up into `uptime_monitor_daily` inside the state-write transaction - `bumpPagesForMonitors` raises `revision` on a flip, pause, resume or delete - `@maple/domain/status-page` adds the snapshot schema, bars, freshness and overlay - Org deletion queues `status_page_cleanups` rows for the publisher to drain ### Before merge - [ ] **Migration** · Check it is safe on production data and with the code still deployed · [`packages/db/drizzle/20261028151515_status_pages/migration.sql`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/d99965e0e6ceb8763e903c61ea51eae965ebfdcb/packages/db/drizzle/20261028151515_status_pages/migration.sql) ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · Resolving an incident through the overlay leaves its components major_outage correctness · [`packages/domain/src/status-page.ts:249`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/d99965e0e6ceb8763e903c61ea51eae965ebfdcb/packages/domain/src/status-page.ts#L249) `withIncidentImpact` (line 310) adds an active incident's impact onto `component.status`, which the publisher already derived from that same incident via `deriveComponentStatus` (line 292), so the overlay can only ever raise a component's status. A break-glass entry that sets an incident in the snapshot to `resolved` therefore shows "Resolved" next to a component and banner that stay `major_outage` until Maple republishes — the state the overlay exists to handle while Maple is down. The tests only resolve incidents the overlay opened itself, so the snapshot's component status is `operational` there and the case goes unseen. ``` Carry the incident-free status on the snapshot component (e.g. a `baseStatus` the publisher fills) and derive from it in `withIncidentImpact`, or keep incident impact out of `component.status` and apply it only through the overlay. ```
What was checked - Retried check batches cannot double count: reports at or before the stored last check are dropped (`UptimeMonitorsService.ts:981`) and only rows the fenced UPDATE applied are counted (line 1043) - A missing heartbeat cannot inflate its day: `isHeartbeatOverdue` returns false once the monitor is down (`UptimeAlertSource.ts:51`) - Every new table carries `tenantColumn: orgId` and is registered purged or unpurged, which `org-scoped-tables.test.ts` enforces
Observability coverage: 1 of 1 changes observable | Change | Kind | Observable | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | uptime daily row upsert (DB write on probe batch, heartbeat ping and missed heartbeat) | database write inside existing flows | yes | Runs inside the existing `recordChecks` / `UptimeAlertSource.observe` spans through `dbExecute`; `applyPing` stays `Effect.fnUntraced` per the hot-path convention. |
